## Checklist

- [ ] The diff is small and surgical; one concern per pull request.
- [ ] No tokens, API keys, `.env` files, or other secrets are included.
- [ ] Docs are updated where behavior changed, and any links resolve.
- [ ] Tests are added or updated for behavior changes (once `packages/*` exist).
- [ ] Commit messages are in English and use `feat:` / `fix:` / `chore:` / `docs:` prefixes.
